original_test_intent: Validate TEMP_GB_HSC1 through TEMP_GB_HSC10 as ten distinct GB hot-swap-controller thermal channels, each tied to its controller and power path, with matching identity, readings and state across complete IB/OOB SDR, Sensor List and BMC Web evidence.
original_method: The board owner supplies the GB HSC population, controller-to-rail/slot mapping, sensing location and condition-specific limits; automation passively enumerates and reconciles ten exact sensor records without changing power or cooling state.
manual_activity: The GB power/thermal owner maps HSC1–HSC10 to physical controller devices, rails and monitored locations, defines sensor type and approves operating limits. No power-path manipulation or log clear is authorized.
required_inputs: GB assembly and revision plus HSC1–HSC10 fitted population
Per-index HSC controller part/serial, physical location and supplied rail/load mapping
Sensor source as controller die, board probe, inlet/ambient proxy or derived value
Exact SDR entity/name/description and Sensor List/Web mapping per member
Units, scaling, resolution, tolerance, freshness and unavailable semantics
Approved limits and enabled thresholds by input voltage, load, redundancy, cooling and ambient condition
Same-target IB/OOB identity and BMC/SDR/GB/HSC specification revisions
Secret-safe complete collectors and independent power/thermal/BMC recovery
safety_requirements: Enumerate HSC1 through HSC10 separately; never treat the tilde label as one record
Bind each sensor to the correct controller, rail/load and physical sensing point before applying limits
Retain complete IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List before filters and capture BMC Web evidence
Do not switch rails, hot-plug modules, alter load/fans/thresholds, reset BMC or clear logs
Keep credentials out of process listings and retained evidence
Stop on HSC population mismatch, power fault, unsafe temperature, stale/invalid reading or path disagreement; no automatic retry
agent_execution_scope: Verify exact row/variant, GB/HSC topology and same-target IB/OOB identity
Passively collect complete SDR and Sensor List plus ten exact mapped HSC records
Compare identity, descriptions, values, units and states across views
Prepare Web parity plus passive rail/load/fan/ambient/SEL context
Perform no power-path, load, cooling, threshold or verdict action
engineer_actions: Provide operating-condition ranges and threshold policy
Confirm ten Web entries and unpopulated handling
Review evidence and issue PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED

modernized_recommendation.status: REQUIRES GB HSC POWER-TOPOLOGY, SENSOR-SEMANTICS AND LIMIT PACKAGE
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Reconcile a ten-row HSC-to-device/rail/load/sensing-point matrix against complete IB/OOB and Web snapshots taken in one stable operating condition.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds power-domain and physical sensing provenance needed to interpret HSC temperature correctly.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: The neighboring UBB HSC range begins at zero and has eight members; it is not an alternate enumeration of this ten-channel GB family.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A die sensor and a nearby board probe may track different transients, and a wrong rail association can hide localized HSC heating despite plausible values.

project_override_considerations: SKU-specific absent HSCs require explicit N/A declarations. Shared sensors or multiple rails per controller require an approved many-to-one coverage rule rather than duplicated values.
expected_evidence: Exact source identity, hash and unique-code lookup
GB/HSC assembly inventory and ten-index controller/rail/load/location matrix
Complete redacted IB/OOB SDR and Sensor List outputs
Ten values/states with units, freshness, load/redundancy/cooling/ambient conditions and approved limits
BMC Web evidence plus passive power/fan/SEL context
Same-target proof, command statuses and artifact hashes
No power/load/fan/write/log-clear audit and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, filters and Criteria consistently target GB HSC1–HSC10 temperature evidence. Missing topology and limits are readiness inputs, not a conflicting purpose.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The ten-channel read-only verification is identifiable; execution awaits project mapping and acceptance data under ED-36.

review_improvement: Connects each GB HSC temperature to a physical hot-swap controller and its rail/load domain, restores all ten members and prevents the adjacent UBB sensor family from satisfying this case.
independent_technical_reasoning: Hot-swap controllers dissipate heat according to the current flowing through their assigned power path; equal board temperatures do not imply equal controller stress. Acceptance therefore needs controller-to-rail/load provenance and a defined sensing point, not merely ten similarly named IPMI values.
